text: Appeal of Order to Comply (November 25, 2019) for 185 Cosburn Avenue

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated November 25, 2019, regarding the property located at 185 Cosburn Avenue, Folder No. 19 251990 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to July 1, 2020.
